name: Interferon-alpha and OAS innate antiviral response
rationale: All members describe innate antiviral defence (virus and cytosolic DNA sensing, IP-10, IFN-alpha response, OAS), and the IFN-alpha/OAS effector arm distinguishes it from confusables centred on IRF3-driven type I IFN induction, RIG-I/MDA5 or cGAS-STING regulation.

name: Presynaptic modulation of glutamate and GABA transmission
rationale: Members cover kainate/AMPA/metabotropic glutamate and GABA signalling, presynaptic calcium and membrane potential, vesicle exocytosis and short-term plasticity, whereas confusables emphasise postsynaptic receptor clustering, nicotinic receptors and inhibitory synapse assembly.

name: Actin-driven leading-edge protrusion in migrating cells
rationale: All members promote actin polymerisation, lamellipodia, pseudopodia and leading-edge localisation for motility, unlike confusables about negative regulation of migration, WASP/WAVE-Arp2/3 nucleation, or actin severing and depolymerisation.

name: Myeloid progenitor lineage commitment and megakaryocyte-erythroid differentiation
rationale: Members regulate myeloid progenitor fate choices (granulocyte, monocyte, macrophage, erythroid, megakaryocyte) via RUNX1 and related programmes, combining megakaryocyte-erythroid branches absent from granulocyte-focused confusables with myeloid-restraint terms absent from erythroid/HSC confusables.

core: Oxidative and hypoxic stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis
name: Oxidative and hypoxic stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis and calcium flux
rationale: Members regulate H2O2-, oxidative-stress- and hypoxia-induced intrinsic cell death and mitochondrial depolarisation, and the plasma membrane calcium import/export and muscle apoptosis terms separate it from confusables about MOMP, respiration and ferroptosis.

name: Resection-dependent double-strand break repair and BRCA-PALB2 defects
rationale: All members concern end resection and downstream HR, SSA and MMEJ repair or their BRCA1/BARD1/BRCA2/PALB2 loss-of-function defects, unlike confusables centred on NHEJ, DSB sensing/ATM, PARylation or Fanconi crosslink repair.

core: HDL biogenesis and reverse cholesterol transport
name: ApoA-I/ABCA1-mediated HDL biogenesis and reverse cholesterol transport
rationale: Members cover HDL particle assembly, apoA-I signalling, ABCA1 deficiency, cholesterol efflux and HDL clearance, distinct from confusables on LXR-regulated efflux, lipoprotein remodelling and phospholipid efflux.

name: Bone and tooth mineralization and osteoclast remodeling
rationale: Members span bone, dentin, enamel and cementum mineralisation, odontogenesis, osteoclast differentiation and resorption and their PTH/FGF23-Klotho/phosphate controls, versus confusables on phosphate transporters or IGF responses.

name: FGFR4-betaKlotho signaling via FRS2 and SHC adaptors
rationale: All three members are FGFR4/betaKlotho ligand binding and its FRS and SHC cascades, distinguishing it from confusables on FGFR1-3 or PI3K/PLC-gamma branches.

name: p53-driven intrinsic apoptosis and execution, including PAK-2p34
rationale: Members run from p53-regulated apoptotic transcription and BH3/BAX/BAK activation through cytochrome c release, apoptosome, caspases and DNA fragmentation; the p53 arm separates it from extrinsic/necroptosis confusables and the PAK-2p34 members from its near-twin.

name: Respiratory chain complex biogenesis and mitochondrial translation elongation
rationale: Members are assembly of complexes I, III, IV, ATP synthase and respirasome, inner-membrane insertion and mitochondrial translation elongation, whereas confusables are electron transport/ATP synthesis itself or translation initiation/termination.

core: Endosomal recycling to the plasma membrane
name: Endosomal recycling and post-Golgi delivery to the plasma membrane
rationale: Members cover receptor and endocytic recycling, endosome organisation, plasma membrane-endosome traffic and Golgi-to-surface transport, distinct from confusables on ARF/Rab-regulated Golgi budding or retrograde endosome-to-Golgi traffic.

name: Epithelial anion and cation transporters and inherited transport disorders
rationale: Members are CFTR, SLC26, SLC4, SLC12 and NHE transport of chloride, bicarbonate, sulfate, iodide and cations with their channelopathies and transepithelial salt/water flux, unlike confusables on osmosensing, aquaporins or CO2 hydration/pH.

name: Glycoside-sensitive Na+/K+-ATPase ion gradient maintenance
rationale: Members are P-type ATPase ion transport, Na+ and K+ homeostasis, electrochemical gradient and cardiac glycoside response, versus confusables on regulated Na+ channels, Mg2+/tight junctions, NHE or V-ATPase acidification.

name: SWI/SNF (BAF) and CHD/NuRD chromatin remodeling complexes
rationale: Members are BAF complex variants, CHD subfamilies and NuRD interactions with stem-cell maintenance, distinguishing it from confusables on histone acetylation, nucleosome assembly or ChAHP.

name: Perivascular stroma and endothelium with IL-33-driven chemotaxis
rationale: Members are fibroblast, perivascular and endothelial gene modules with adhesion, IL-33 signalling and positive chemotaxis, while confusables lack the endothelial/IL-33 components and instead carry generic ECM, KRAS or fibroblast proliferation sets.

name: Thymic T cell development, selection and early activation
rationale: Members cover thymocyte selection, proliferation, survival and migration, lineage differentiation including Tregs, tolerance and T cell activation modules, versus confusables on B cell/Tfh or proximal TCR costimulation signalling.

qualifier: galactose, fructose and glycerol with inborn errors
name: Galactose, fructose and glycerol metabolism and inborn errors
rationale: Members are Leloir galactose catabolism, fructose and glycerol/alditol metabolism and their enzyme deficiencies, unlike confusables on lactose digestion, pentose pathways or glucose/glycogen metabolism.

name: Mitochondrial fission-fusion dynamics and protein recruitment to mitochondria
rationale: Members regulate mitochondrial fission, fusion, fragmentation, membrane potential and protein localisation to mitochondria, distinct from confusables on import machinery, PINK1-PRKN mitophagy or MOMP-driven apoptosis.

name: Sympathoadrenal development and noradrenaline-adrenaline biosynthesis
rationale: Members combine norepinephrine/epinephrine synthesis with noradrenergic neuron, sympathetic ganglion and adrenal development, unlike confusables on monoamine degradation, serotonin, enteric neural crest or neuroblast proliferation.

core: Mitochondrial carbon entry and TCA cycle
name: PDH-mediated acetyl-CoA entry, coenzyme A synthesis and TCA cycle
rationale: Members cover pyruvate decarboxylation by PDH, CoA/pantothenate synthesis and TCA intermediates (isocitrate, 2-oxoglutarate, succinate, malate), separating it from confusables on Fe-S maturation, carboxylate transport or OGDH/lipoylation.

name: Male meiotic recombination and synapsis in spermatogenesis
rationale: Members are meiotic DSB formation, synapsis and recombination in male meiosis I plus spermatogenic structures (Sertoli barrier, manchette, sperm mitochondria), distinct from confusables on fertilisation, zygotic/germline epigenetics or gonadal hormones.

qualifier: germinal centre, memory and plasma cell
name: B cell identity, germinal centre and plasma/memory differentiation
rationale: Members are B cell signatures, germinal centre and Tfh/ICOS/CD27 help, memory and plasma cell differentiation, unlike confusables on proximal BCR signalling or T cell development.

qualifier: NK cell expansion and NF-kB inflammatory activation
name: IL-15/IL-21 signaling, NK cell expansion and NF-kB inflammatory activation
rationale: Members are IL-15/IL-21 and STAT signalling, NK cell proliferation/differentiation and NF-kB-driven TNF/IL-23 activation modules, distinct from confusables on IL-2/IL-7, IL-10/IL-27 family or type 2/mast cell cytokines.

qualifier: tuning in B cell development and proliferation
name: BCR signaling and its tuning in developing B cells
rationale: Members cover BCR second messengers, BTK/RAS, CD22 and inhibitory brakes with B cell development, proliferation and homeostasis, separating it from confusables on T cell activation, Fc receptors or B cell surface/plasma cell signatures.
